scope: Minimal check of the one-click rest change only.

action_smoke_check.method: Execute the actual open function in Node with mocked state and send hooks.
cases: One activation prepares the UI, stops movement and sends rest with kind short.
Activation during an active rest sends rest_cancel.
A combat-blocked client snapshot still sends the request for authoritative server validation and its existing notice.

review: The rest UI no longer creates or opens a dialog.
The HUD and merchant buttons share the direct short-rest action.
The source change does not alter the server's rest timing, healing or combat gate.
Above-character progress and animation remain unchanged from UI_03.
